question: A 23-year-old man comes to the physician because of a 1-week history of muscle ache, fatigue, and fever that occurs every 2 days. He recently returned from a trip to Myanmar. A peripheral blood smear shows erythrocytes with brick-red granules. The physician recommends a combination of two antimicrobial drugs after confirming normal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity. Which of the following is the most appropriate rationale for dual therapy?
